nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: Vane's done. Ledger did him in. And the paperwork, Calloway — the paperwork found ME. Reyes left forty pages of it and a note that says 'try'.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: ...Page one's done. Don't spread it around. A reputation for effort is a dangerous thing in my line of napping.

nodes.speaker: Sheriff Bly
nodes.text: You've been talking to Preacher. Nobody needs this much character before lunch.
